SB 69    # Spec #1 cases (b), (c), (e), (f): SB 69-2 adopted by SLB on 2025-01-30; Versions Introduced, A-Engrossed, Enrolled and "Senate Amendments to Introduced"; -1 posted to three meetings.

HB 3131  # Spec #1 cases (d), (e): 42 Testimony rows, 41 support and 1 oppose; Fiscal and Revenue Impact Statements for the Introduced Version.

# Measures whose Fiscal Impact Statements name Agencies. Each was chosen by reading the statement
# in the cached samples (documents-sample-1/ and documents-sample-2/); the quoted line is its
# "Government Unit(s) Affected:" line as pdftotext printed it.
SB 121   # Revenue impact statement. Measures.RevenueImpact reads "Revenue impact issued" and the feed links Revenue Impact Statement 90375 (Introduced). Fiscal Impact Statement (sample-1 MeasureAnalysisDocuments_20): "Government Unit(s) Affected: Judicial Department, Department of Revenue".
SB 983   # A unit that is not a state agency. Introduced Fiscal Impact Statement (sample-1 MeasureAnalysisDocuments_21): "Government Unit(s) Affected: Cities, Counties, School Districts, Special Districts, Metro, TriMet".
HB 3027  # A statement naming several Agencies. Introduced Fiscal Impact Statement (sample-1 CommitteeMeetingDocuments_18): "Government Unit(s) Affected: Higher Education Coordinating Commission, Department of Justice, Judicial Department".
SB 921   # Alias. A-Engrossed Fiscal Impact Statement (sample-1 MeasureAnalysisDocuments_19): "Government Unit(s) Affected: Oregon Business Development Department", and the statement then says "OBDD" for the same Agency throughout. No sampled statement spells "ODHS" in its unit line; see README.md.

# Chosen for a document, not for a Fiscal Impact Statement.
SB 64    # A document with no text layer. Committee Meeting Document 288141, "Working Family Household and Dependent Care - Tax Expenditure Report" (SHS, 2025-01-23), is a 2-page PDF where pdftotext finds no text (sample-2 CommitteeMeetingDocuments_24, 143,004 bytes).
